LanguageData.DS_AutoIngestDesc: When enabled, the core automatically absorbs nearby loose items each tick without requiring hauling. Stops when unpowered.
LanguageData.DS_CostMultiplierDesc: Adjust material cost for all buildings and items.
LanguageData.DS_EnableDebugLogDesc: Print detailed debug information to the log.
LanguageData.DS_AutoIngestToggleDesc: Allow cores to absorb loose items automatically instead of waiting for a hauler. Turn this off if items seem to teleport around the map.
LanguageData.DS_StorageFilterDesc: Set which item types are allowed into this core. All allowed by default.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_Letter30_Text:
Digital Storage 3.1 maintenance update 2026.5.27.

[Buffer Warehouse Redesign]
- Single-item mode: one warehouse locks to one item type, auto-locked on first restock
- No pawn haul-in: items fully visible, blocked only at haul routing layer
- Hidden item render: items on shelf are not drawn
- Storage filter defaults to disallow all + ITab manual unlock button
- DSU IO-port inspired architecture: items free, only haul direction blocked

[Fixed]
- Trade quantity loss: PostClose rogue rollback from non-trade windows
- Trade duplicate entries: Prefix injection into deal.AllTradeables
- Auto-ingest no longer routes items to buffer warehouses
- Core shadow removed + visual rotation disabled

Thank you for your support! Bug reports: QQ group 693252771.
